title: tabernaemontana elastica
intro: Tabernaemontana elastica, commonly known as the "Sipo Tree," is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including treating various conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, and inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilator. The bioactive constituents of Tabernaemontana elastica include alkaloids, particularly voacangine and voacristine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat pain, fever, and respiratory issues.
